---
name: code-review
description: Make code review before or after Git commit has happened.
allowed-tools: shell
---

Use Git branch that is currently active.

Pay attention to:

1. Code style.
2. Find bugs (security, code smells, logic errors, etc).
3. Give performance summary, in terms of Big O, for various code blocks.
4. Suggest improvements (optimize performance, possible place to apply design patterns).
